history.summary: Compact freehold 1BR (484 sqft) at Cubik, a small D15 boutique block in Geylang/East Coast fringe. Asking $1,746 psf is ~4% above the $1,682 median on a very thin 11-txn series, so the 4.2%/yr appreciation rate is statistically unreliable.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold and D15 deep buyer pool are pluses, but this is a boutique development with only 11 URA transactions — the 4.2%/yr rate carries low confidence. PSF $1,746 is a premium to the $1,682 median, and 1.08km to Marine Terrace MRT is a long walk. Small freehold 1BR rents adequately but offers no clear appreciation edge; fairly-to-slightly-richly priced.
red_flags: Thin 11-txn URA series — appreciation rate unreliable
Boutique block, 1.08km from MRT — shallow liquidity for a 1BR
catalysts: East Coast lifestyle / TEL Marine Terrace within walkable-ish distance
